newsitem.title: USA: HighwayMaster, SBC Communications in pact.
newsitem.headline: HighwayMaster, SBC Communications in pact.

text.p: HighwayMaster Communications Inc said Monday SBC Communications Inc agreed to make a $20 million equity investment in HighwayMaster.
SBC's initial investment will be in preferred stock, which is convertible into common at the rate of $12.50 per share, HighwayMaster said.

In addition to its preferred stock, SBC will receive five million warrants, three million of which are exercisable for common stock at $14 per share, with the remaining two million exercisable at $18 per share.

SBC's preferred stock, if converted to common shares, would represent about a six percent stake in HighwayMaster. Upon exercise of all of the associated warrants, SBC's percent ownership would rise to about 20 percent, the company said.
In addition to the equity investment by SBC, HighwayMaster said some of its original investors agreed to make additional investments.
The Erin Mills Group invested an additional $10 million in common stock and has converted $10.8 million of existing preferred stock to common, HighwayMaster said.
The Carlyle Group, the Clipper Group, and related investors also converted $12.7 million of debt due to mature on December 31, 1996, to common stock.
Each of these transactions has been completed at $12.50 per share.
Combining the above deals, HighwayMaster said it raised $30 million in cash and increased shareholder equity by more than $50 million.
